Subject: Re: Local maildir delivery problem

> postfix/local[67441]: send attr reason = maildir delivery failed:
> create maildir file
> /home/cc/.maildir/new/1203783544.V6eI353005M247564.isaac.xlocal.net:
> Operation not permitted

What are the permissions (use "ls -ld") of:

/
/home
/home/cc
/home/cc/.maildir
/home/cc/.maildir/new

The l receiving user must have execute access on directories that
already exist, and must have write permission to create any missing
directories, as well as the mail file itself.

	Wietse
